editorial_thesis: The durable advantage is moving up one layer—from model novelty to maintained execution infrastructure: skills, semantic data, and governed protocol control planes.

topic_groups.title: Agent Skills + Reliable Automation
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh Google Cloud engineering detail turns reusable agent instructions into a testable product discipline; System Initiative and Cloudflare add practical execution controls.

sources.title: Google Agent Skills operations
sources.why_selected: Describes standardized skills, CI checks, ownership, and recurring evaluations.
sources.usefulness: Provides a concrete template for Buildn skill packaging and regression tests.

sources.title: Google skills repository
sources.why_selected: Primary implementation surface for the skills approach.
sources.usefulness: Can be compared directly with existing Buildn skills.

sources.title: System Initiative infrastructure agents
sources.why_selected: Shows a plan-review-approve-execute model against a digital twin.
sources.usefulness: Useful pattern for bounded automation and client delivery workflows.

sources.title: Cloudflare unified AI control plane
sources.why_selected: Connects model routing with cost, latency, and request observability.

topic_groups.title: Knowledge Graphs + Agent-Ready Data
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Knowledge management and data semantics are under-covered relative to agent tooling; today’s Google Cloud signals make graph-backed, permissioned context concrete.

sources.title: Spanner Graph + Data Commons
sources.why_selected: Announces graph-backed integration of public and private data with GraphRAG patterns.
sources.usefulness: Informs connected artifact, evidence, and decision retrieval.

sources.title: Cortex Framework v7
sources.why_selected: Shows semantic enterprise data products, incremental pipelines, and extensibility boundaries.
sources.usefulness: Provides a model for stable canonical schemas plus client extensions.

sources.title: 2026 KM Priorities and Trends Survey
sources.why_selected: Supplies a current knowledge-management baseline around AI integration and maturity.
sources.usefulness: Suggests ownership, freshness, and reuse metrics for Buildn knowledge health.

topic_groups.title: MCP Infrastructure + Control Planes
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The MCP protocol and model gateway layer are converging on ordinary web infrastructure, creating immediate portability and observability decisions.

sources.title: The next generation of MCP
sources.why_selected: Explains stateless MCP, request-scoped deployment, routing, and authorization changes.
sources.usefulness: Guides classification of tools by state and idempotency.

sources.title: Cloudflare AI control plane
sources.why_selected: Adds unified model access, telemetry, billing, and routing direction.
sources.usefulness: Supports mandatory cost and latency fields on agent calls.

sources.title: System Initiative infrastructure agents
sources.why_selected: Demonstrates control boundaries around autonomous infrastructure changes.
